reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code answer my first question, is it really tested. At $24.99 with an empty-box guarantee I would try one box, since I already take something in the evening after the gym.
objection: A lab report on their own page is only as good as the lab. I would want to check that the lab is real and that the batch number on my box matches before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab turned out to be unknown or the report did not match the batch number, I would not buy. A price under $20 for the first box would make me add a second one.
